model_disagreement.note: Task, horizon and generation never mix. Ranges use probability units for winner and points for score (home, away). Models share inputs, training data and ensemble members; they are correlated, not independent votes. Dispersion is not calibrated uncertainty or evidence of accuracy. Initial-horizon observations may have different observation times.

ratings.note: Opponent-Adjusted EPA, not DVOA. Joint ridge offense/defense effects on nflverse EPA, which already accounts for situation. Positive defense means EPA prevented; positive net is better. Fixed 200-play ridge penalty is an assumption, not tuned evidence. Matchup features freeze before each week; no same-week results. Week 1 and absent teams remain missing. Revised historical EPA is not proof of original availability. Latest rankings include all completed source games and must not be used for historical predictions. Big plays: pass >=20 yards or rush >=10 yards. Sack differential: made minus allowed. Rates use dropbacks for sacks, scrimmage plays for big plays. No production-model change or proven predictive improvement.

matched_feature_evaluation.note: Identical fixed logistic/Ridge pipelines and chronological annual folds; baseline = prior-eight-game score form + raw offensive EPA. Each added view differs only in features. Median imputation/scaling fit only on training. Paired 95% intervals resample season-week clusters (1,000 draws, seed42). No multiple-comparison correction; designed after historical seasons. Retrospective evidence only; no automatic promotion.

matched_recipe_evaluation.comparison_note: Production Random Forest estimator recipe refitted on IDENTICAL candidate features, rows and temporal calibration: base through 2024, calibration 2025, test 2026. Candidates selected using 2025 only. This is not the saved live model performance. GPR is excluded because its fit/calibration protocol differs. Paired 95% intervals resample weeks; small sample, revised sources and post-hoc design; no multiplicity correction or automatic promotion.

matched_baselines.note: Exact shared game IDs and verified identical outcomes across all five models. EPA models use historical_metrics annual chronological fits; simple form/home frequency use rolling_backtest weekly fits; Elo uses advanced_backtest weekly-frozen ratings (K20, home55, offseason75%). Matched holdout cohort, NOT identical training windows or a causal estimator comparison. Raw EPA includes simple score form; not EPA-only. Revised historical data, post-hoc intersection, season-week paired bootstrap, no multiplicity correction or production promotion.

special_teams.status: Partial: descriptive only; opponent adjustment not fitted
special_teams.note: Descriptive raw special-teams EPA only; NOT opponent-adjusted, DVOA, a fitted rating, or predictive evaluation. Selection is special_teams_play==1 OR kickoff/punt/field-goal/extra-point attempt flags, excluding no_play. EPA is credited as recorded to posteam and negated for defteam. On kickoffs posteam may be the receiving side; these are possession-side credits, not kicker/offense attribution. No player or causal claim. Only completed regular-season games with finite EPA and both teams matching the schedule are used. Minimum display coverage is 20 valid plays across 2 games per team, a reporting rule not statistical validation. Latest revised snapshot, not pregame availability evidence; missing plays are not zero.

opponent_adjusted.note: Existing Opponent-Adjusted EPA, not DVOA. Latest ratings are descriptive, not historical inputs. Feature-value comparisons and matched estimator-recipe comparisons answer different questions; neither is a newly measured production improvement.

historical_evaluation.note: Research Ridge score model, not the serving ensemble. Weekly refits; coverage uses only residuals from earlier held-out weeks. Paired empirical residuals, 10,000 draws, seed 42; rounded and clipped to nonnegative scores. Approximate score distribution, not a football scoring-process model. Three-class Brier is the summed squared error for above/below/push; lower is better. Historical market evaluation uses revised source lines, not verified pregame snapshots. Homogeneous errors and integer rounding can miscalibrate cover/over/push probabilities. Prospective evaluation starts only after archiving; never backfilled.

joint_scores.method: Existing research Ridge paired-residual joint score distribution
joint_scores.note: Reuses saved score_distribution exports without generating or capturing forecasts. The existing model resamples paired home/away out-of-sample residuals (last 512; minimum 128), 10,000 draws, seed 42, rounded/clipped at zero. Winner/tie, margin, total and market probabilities derive from the same joint draws, not independent score marginals. Saved training date must precede kickoff date. Weekly historical evaluation used only earlier residuals; revised lines are not verified pregame lines. These are research-model summaries, not a distribution fitted to shadow_next or production point forecasts; no full joint PMF was saved. Historical coverage does not establish calibration for each saved generation.

grouped_ablation.note: True drop-group refits, not masking. Fixed logistic C=1/Ridge alpha=10; identical games/annual chronological folds; training-only imputation/scaling. Positive loss delta means removal hurt. Personnel snapshots are same-season, strictly earlier than target-week cutoff, joined by team before home-away differencing. QB last-five rollups are additionally lagged; injury/roster are PRIOR-game proxies, not current availability or confirmed starters. Advanced source ends 2025, so personnel experiment excludes 2026. Coverage counts precede imputation; original upstream QB zero fills are inherited. Revised historical snapshots do not prove publication-time availability. Season-week bootstrap; no multiplicity correction; post-hoc design. Form inherits 21-point cold-start assumption. No causal or production improvement claim.

input_availability.note: Receipt ages are local observation ages, not provider publication times or proof of current coverage. Stale thresholds: injuries/weather/starters 24h, weekly performance/rosters 72h. Charted inputs remain frozen. Confirmed starters and weather are displayed but NOT features of these models. Copied receipt/publication timestamps are not proof of game-specific coverage. Missing games stay unknown; current freshness is not historical pregame evidence.

weekly_recap.note: All scheduled games, including missing predictions and pending results. Saved production winner and score tasks graded independently; no backfill. Genuine pregame requires an explicit timezone-aware timestamp strictly before actual kickoff, not merely a timestamp present. Legacy/missing/late evidence is separate and never contributes to genuine metrics. Timestamp provenance is not a full input or training audit. Model generations remain separate; ties excluded only for winner grading. No inference from legacy prediction_correct fields.
